title: Capability
description: One capability an upstream application needs, where it would live on Cloudflare, and how far that is proven.

id.description: Stable id, unique within the assessment.

upstreamEvidence.description: Evidence ids that show the upstream has this capability.

candidate.description: The implementation proposed or built, naming the primitive (a TapeDB API, a Cloudflare product, application code).

candidateEvidence.description: Evidence ids that show the candidate does what is claimed.

gaps.description: Semantic differences from the upstream behaviour.

owner.description: Who closes the gaps: tapedb, cloudflare, application, or a person.

acceptanceTests.description: Test ids that would show the capability works.
